newsitem.title: USA: NetLive says terminated talks with suitor.
newsitem.headline: NetLive says terminated talks with suitor.

text.p: NetLive Communications Inc said Monday its board has ended all negotiations with Zodiac Group Inc, a private telephone entertainment network that on February 7 announced an offer to merge with the company.
NetLive, in a statement, said it had not been considering any similar proposals and the unsolicited transaction proposed by Zodiac was a significant departure from its business plan.
NetLive said it held "very preliminary" discussions with the Boca Raton, Fla.,-based Zodiac but no substantial negotiations were held.
It said this was in part due to Zodiac's failure to provide with NetLive's requests for information.
In light of Zodiac's "lack of cooperation" and other factors, NetLive said its board determined that a merger with Zodiac was not in the best interests of the company or its stockholderrs.

NetLive is an Internet company that provides video call centers. It said it plans to launch the first live, videoconferenced psychic, tarot card and astrological guidance service over the Internet in the spring.
